pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0133 Remote AI Studio first release
pr_body:
## Summary

- add exact-head Remote AI Studio browser visual validation using the real loopback gateway and production companion HTML/JS
- seed deterministic Agent Host state only under the `visual-validation` feature
- capture desktop, narrow, and mobile browser viewports plus tall companion evidence
- keep the accepted visual-validation spec version at 1.5 so existing protocol regression remains valid while extending its documented scenario

## Validation

- Windows Validation on the exact final head
- Automation Regression because `scripts/ci/**` changes
- Remote browser visual review at desktop, narrow, and mobile widths
